general_notes: Candidates fall into recurring groups across states: an exact copy with an added border frame; a blurred low-resolution copy; a zoomed crop that cuts off the legs; soft-vignette app presentations (some keep the backdrop and embers, others go near-black with an added halo and lose sparks/smoke); and a 3D render that is a different rendition. The depleted target contains a grey rectangular patch at lower right that some candidates keep and others remove; I treated removing it as neutral to slightly positive for P3. Motion was judged from six still frames only: all sequences show only subtle flame/spark changes with no body motion, so A1/A4 are uncertain and may understate or overstate how the motion feels at playback speed. Differences between near-identical vignette candidates (e.g. idle B vs H, depleted B/G/H) are small and my half-point distinctions there carry low confidence.
